body:
Hi, I was banned for "Anti-knockback".  I never hacked in my life and I never plan to, the only reason it looked like it was anti knockback was because I have bad internet and it looked like that but I was actually fell out of the world when it looked like I was still on the cloud.

I wish to be unbanned please, I have played on this server for a long time and I really love this server.


Thanks,
Penguin_4444
